event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: IDs of the log events to export (1-500 items).

format.title: Format
format.description: Output format: 'text' for a human-readable listing, 'json' for structured rows.

include_phi.title: Include Phi
include_phi.description: Export message content unmasked. Requires the 'Unredact PHI' (logs.unredact) permission (403 otherwise); left out, PHI is masked.
